profile.headline: Software Engineer at Macromill in Japan
profile.summary:
- Multi lingual Software Dev professional with 8 years experience across US and Japanese teams 
- Built notification engine for Chewy directly increasing profits by 350k weekly
- Previously Hire #130 at Toast Inc, now a national Point of Sale staple
- Former Software Engineer at Catalant Inc where I utilized Jinja2 and Python to develop the full stack of a web platform that allows large companies find the right talent to get mission critical work done faster

- Previously Technical Escalations Engineer at Toast Inc and handled the most sensitive technical issues escalated to the Engineering department. Personally resolved 30% of all escalated issues company-wide and lowered issue response time from 12 to 3 days.

- Graduated from University of Massachusetts, Amherst with a Bachelor’s in Business Administration with a GPA of 3.7 with Cum Laude honors. 

- Business Conversational in Japanese, Conversational in Chinese and Spanish

positions.title: Software Engineer EXP 2
positions.description: Skills: Japanese Business Culture · Japanese · Go (Programming Language) · Product Design

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description: Developed Notification System increase company profits by 350k weekly. Utilized AWS suite, SpringBoot Java and Terraform for infrastructure. Rolled out short term solution in 3 months then developed long term robust solution. Notifications remind customers to renew their Pet Health prescriptions so they don’t have a delay in care. Value of project was recognized by Executive leadership.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Skilled in Android and Web Development, with proven expertise in managing two Mobile Applications for package delivery, a customer-facing website for scheduling redeliveries, and implementing front-end features for a mobile application used by millions. Demonstrated proficiency in utilizing Kotlin, React and Springboot to develop robust APIs and streamline data exports for e-commerce websites, allowing users to download selected data as spreadsheets. Consistently strives for excellence in designing efficient and user-friendly interfaces to optimize performance and enhance user experience.

Additionally, I have developed cultural competence in working in a foreign work environment and frequently communicate with colleagues in Japanese.
positions.insights: Skills: Amazon Web Services (AWS) · Microsoft Azure · Open API · Japanese Business Culture · Kotlin · Spring Boot · React.js · Redis · Java · Android Development

positions.title: Animator
positions.description: Produced and directed the animated segment of Brandon Coleman's music video 'Be With Me,' featured on his album 'Interstellar Black Space.' Collaborated with Grammy-winning artist Flying Lotus, who oversaw the project and has produced renowned artists including Thundercat and Kendrick Lamar, and also produced the Netflix anime series 'Yasuke.' Created a visually striking and engaging animation that complemented the music and helped elevate the video to new heights.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Played an instrumental role in developing a highly effective web application utilizing Flask and Jinja2, built on top of Python, that empowers businesses to adopt a more agile operating model by providing company leadership with improved access to internal talent, streamlining project delivery timelines. Contributed to the development of the Catalant platform, leveraged by over 50,000+ individuals and several Fortune 100 companies. Employed various technologies including Javascript, HTML/CSS3, JQuery, Bootstrap, and SQLAlchemy to develop an intuitive and responsive interface for the platform, enhancing user experience and optimizing functionality.
positions.insights: Skills: Flask · Bootstrap · JavaScript · SQLAlchemy · Python

positions.title: Technical Escalations Engineer
positions.description:
As a skilled Engineer, I triage and resolve sensitive issues escalated to the Engineering department. Leveraging my expertise in deciphering server and app logs, debugging on web and mobile platforms, and diagnosing bugs, I personally solve an average of 30% of all incoming issues. I utilize my extensive product knowledge to implement bug fixes, perform configurations, and conduct manual QA. I'm proficient in a wide range of technologies including Java, PostgreSQL, GitHub, Sumologic, IntelliJ IDEA, Android Studio, Sentry, Jenkins, Docker, JIRA, Salesforce, LaunchDarkly, and Bash. Since joining the company, I have lowered issue response time by 75%.

I led the development of an internal webpage using Java, JQuery, Play Framework (UI template), and HTML that streamlined restaurant menu pricing settings, reducing configuration time from O(n) to O(1) in the Bulk Edit Internal Tooling Project. I also contributed to the Configuration UI Validation Project by adding validation to multiple pages to prevent bad data, using Java, Javascript, Play Framework, HTML, CSS3, and Jenkins.

It's worth noting that I was the 130th employee to join the company, which has since grown to over 1,500 people and achieved a valuation of $1.4 billion.

positions.title: Lead Inventory Software Configuration Specialist
positions.description:
-Configured Point of Sale, Inventory module, Online Ordering for 15+ restaurants at any given time and conducted customer product training
-Managed enterprise level client’s most technical configurations, such as designing national restaurant chain Brass Taps’s 50+ location menu
-Automated Software Configuration Project - Developed custom automation for customers which took a CSV template and configured it into the product saving over 100 hours of labor cost
Technologies Used: Java, Selenium, XPath
-Toastie Award Nominee - Given to outstanding Employee companywide

positions.title: ESL Language Consultant
positions.description: As an ESL Language Consultant, I have added more than 100 lesson plans to the resource database, enriching the learning experience for both students and instructors. Conducting six daily English language classes for adults across seven different skill levels, I have been recognized on multiple occasions for my exceptional performance. Through my work, I have developed an intuition for nurturing relationships with people of diverse backgrounds and foreign cultures.

positions.title: Global Systems Transaction Processor Associate
positions.description: As a Global Systems Transactions Processor Associate, I corrected invalid input on various types of global money trade transactions. I specialized in fixing account-specific invalid transaction issues, which required a nuanced understanding of the correct input required for a successful international money transfer. My exceptional performance in this role led to my promotion to specialized account-specific processing.
